scenarios.disabled_reason: TLS 1.3 has no NULL/integrity-only cipher suite; OpenSSL does not implement the draft TLS_SHA256_SHA256/TLS_SHA384_SHA384 codepoints, so an integrity-only TLS 1.3 handshake negotiates zero ciphersuites and never completes. Integrity-only is TLS 1.2 only — SCG now rejects the combination at config load (TRA #85). Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_tcp

scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_uds

scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_shm
